description: nav4ai helps independent teachers review their students, groups, and completed homework in ChatGPT. Retrieve teaching context, including requested private notes and completed answers, then create, edit, style, and preview interactive lesson or homework materials. Import approved host-supplied images into materials. Changes to attached materials also update their lesson or homework content in nav4ai.
